consultasBanco.descricao: Catálogo: legal.contract_requirements existe com o nome do livro, é tabela (relkind r), tem company_id e RLS ENABLE+FORCE
consultasBanco.sql: SELECT 'legal.contract_requirements' AS tabela_do_livro, to_regclass('legal.contract_requirements') IS NOT NULL AS existe_com_o_nome_do_livro, c.relkind::text AS tipo, c.relrowsecurity AS rls_enable, c.relforcerowsecurity AS rls_force, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attname = 'company_id' AND NOT a.attisdropped) AS tem_company_id, NULL AS tabela_que_guarda_hoje, f.relkind::text AS tipo_da_que_guarda, f.relrowsecurity AS rls_enable_da_que_guarda, f.relforcerowsecurity AS rls_force_da_que_guarda FROM (SELECT 1) x LEFT JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = to_regclass('legal.contract_requirements') LEFT JOIN pg_class f ON f.oid = to_regclass(NULL)
